bRl.text:
TO ADD BLOCK/ITEM:

Step 1: Follow @griffpatch's tutorial on YT on how to add elements to the block data list

bRn.text:
Step 2: This list determines the order of the items within the creative menu, If its not in this list it wont be in the creative menu.

Find the Block ID of your new block, then slot the item ID before or after another Item Id in the list. This will determine its place in the creative menu. 

Extra Info: The start of a new creative tab is marked as 'E' followed by a number in the list e.g Decorations tab would be 'E2'

bRp.text:
TO ADD CRAFTING RECIPES:

@Griffpatch's tutorial is also quite helpful in this, watch his tutorial on how to add crafting recipes.

Or there is an alternate way:

Open the game and open a crafting table, inside the crafting table; craft the recipe you want to add, nothing should come up... then customise the script below to account for your desired item and then click it to run it.

When you try crafting the item again, it should work this time.
